idea.value: A business that works across borders should run its money from one place; the film says it in short typed lines on two alternating grounds and proves each line with the real product screen or a literal graphic of the claim (a symbol that keeps changing, a counter that runs to zero, a chart that climbs).

audience.value: Owners and finance leads of small and mid-sized companies that pay suppliers and get paid in several currencies, with an emphasis on cross-border markets (Nigerian, Indian, Canadian, US, British and Pakistani flags; diverse portraits of founders and shoppers); the film assumes no prior product knowledge.

value.device: sentence typed into place, then its key word typed letter by letter on the opposite ground and flashed over two crowd photographs without moving
value.description: 0.00-1.17 s: the first clause on cream, two words, then a third at 0.52 s (silent first 0.47 s). 1.17 s hard cut to dark: the key word typed in yellow, a letter every 2 frames. 1.50 s and 1.87 s: two crowd photographs under the finished word, 10 frames each; 2.20 s back to yellow on dark for 7 frames; 2.43 s cut to cream as the sentence turns to the viewer. Five picture changes in 1.27 s against one word that never moves.

value.purpose: Hook: a statement about the world, its key word made visual
value.retentionDevice: letter-by-letter typing creates anticipation; image flash pays it off
value.content: Clause, typed key word, two crowd flashes

value.purpose: Turn the statement to the viewer
value.retentionDevice: people appear as the word 'your' lands: the viewer is placed in the sentence
value.content: Second clause on cream with portrait cards of business owners drifting around it

value.purpose: Name the brand as the answer
value.retentionDevice: a single moving shape holds the eye from a point to the full name
value.content: Dot-to-wordmark build on dark, sub-line, colour settles to white

value.retentionDevice: the wall's speed and density make 'many' felt before the product appears
value.content: Line on cream, then a kinetic wall of the promise's last words with flag chips

value.retentionDevice: the music lifts here (inferred) and the first real interface is shown
value.content: Cropped dashboard drift, then the accounts overview with a summarising caption

value.retentionDevice: symbols keep swapping inside each hold, so each shot keeps changing without a cut
value.content: Symbol disc on a trail, mirrored across a cut, then a line with an inline globe chip
Portrait plates converge around a line; the benefit line on cream

value.retentionDevice: every cut follows a click, so cause and effect carry the viewer through 9.7 s of interface
value.content: Interface page with caption, punch-in on the button, four click cuts through the flow to a success screen, push-in on the result

value.retentionDevice: snap zoom renews attention after the long walkthrough
value.content: Line split around a shopper photo with an embedded checkout card that snap-zooms; then a line on cream

value.purpose: Feature 3: moving money between currencies, instantly
value.retentionDevice: three literal visual puns in 3.5 s, each carried from the last by where the eye already is
value.content: Verb split with interface card inserted; verb opens a gap that becomes an arrow pill with swapping flags; countdown to zero behind a word

value.retentionDevice: a typed figure and a light sweep tell the eye where to read
value.content: Interface builds and types an amount, reframes for a caption, highlight sweeps the rate rows

value.purpose: Payoff: the benefit in the viewer's terms
value.retentionDevice: the only full-frame graphic of growth comes after the last feature, as the reward
value.content: Three benefit lines swapped on cream, then one huge word over a climbing yellow chart, then the line completed small

value.retentionDevice: the film ends quieter and smaller than it began; the address is the last and only thing on screen
value.content: Sign-off line ending on the brand name, then the web address alone

payoff.value: After three features the film shows growth itself: one huge word with a yellow area chart and a counter climbing behind it (41.53-42.33 s), then returns the word to the quiet cream line that completes the benefit.

callToAction.value: A five-word sign-off ending on the brand name, then only the web address, small and centred on cream, held 1.73 s to the end with no fade.

whyItWorks: One sentence, one idea per hold: lines are 2-5 words, held 0.7-1.3 s, and the text never competes with another line.
Every claim gets a literal picture rather than a generic one: 'any' is a symbol that keeps changing, 'instantly' is a counter running to zero, 'between' is an arrow pill in the gap of a split word.
The ground flips between cream and near-black on hard cuts, so the edit has contrast and pace without a single transition effect.
The eye is parked before each cut where the next element will appear (the word gap, the held caption, the disc that becomes the full stop).
Interface walkthroughs are cut on clicks: each cut has a visible cause, so 10 s of product reads as one continuous action.
The visual reward (growth chart) is held back until after the last feature, and the close is smaller and calmer than the open.
